DEFINE INSTRUMENT tof_spectrometer (
E0 = 4.94, // meV] Initial neutron energy [meV
dE = 0.24, // meV] Energy width [meV
dt = 6.4e-06, // s] Time resolution/pulse width [s
string coh = "Rb_liq_coh.sqw", // Coherent S(q,w) sample file
string inc = "Rb_liq_inc.sqw", // Incoherent S(q,w) sample file
thickness = 0.0001, // m] Sample thickness [m
yheight = 0.0168, // m] Sample height [m
radius = 0.005, // m] Sample radius [m
string container = "Nb.laz", // Container material laz file
container_thickness = 5e-05, // m] Container thickness [m
string environment = "Al.laz", // Environment material laz file
environment_radius = 0.025, // m] Environment radius [m
environment_thickness = 0.002, // m] Environment thickness [m
dt0 = 0.0 // s] Time offset / pulse width internal
)

DECLARE 
%{
int flag_single;
int flag_multi;
int flag_env;
int flag_container;
double vi;
double _dt0;
string op[256];
double focus_yh_val;
%}

INITIALIZE 
%{
// Start of initialize for generated tof_spectrometer
%}

TRACE 
COMPONENT a1 = Progress_bar(
 percent = 5)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) ABSOLUTE
EXTEND %{
flag_single=flag_multi=flag_env=flag_container=0;
%}

COMPONENT csource = Source_gen(
 radius = 0.02, dist = 2.88,
 focus_xw = 2*radius, focus_yh = 2*radius,
 E0 = E0, dE = dE/2,
 I1 = 1, T1 = 300)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE a1

COMPONENT SampleIn = Arm()
AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.88) RELATIVE a1

COMPONENT Environment_in = Isotropic_Sqw(
 Sqw_coh = environment, radius = environment_radius,
 thickness = environment_thickness, yheight = 0.1,
 verbose = 0, concentric = 1)
WHEN (environment_thickness > 0)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE SampleIn
EXTEND %{
if (SCATTERED) flag_env=1;
%}

COMPONENT Container_in = Isotropic_Sqw(
 Sqw_coh = container, radius = radius+0.0001+container_thickness,
 thickness = container_thickness, yheight = yheight,
 verbose = 0, concentric = 1)
WHEN (yheight && container_thickness > 0)
